terms.gloss: foreign, neither Greek nor Roman; barbarous; as a noun, a barbarian
evidence: Cic. Mil. 30: sīn hoc et ratiō doctīs et necessitās barbarīs praescrīpsit (Lewis & Short)
Lucr. 6.37: quō neque noster adit quisquam, nec barbarus audet (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Greek βάρβαρος: to the Greeks whoever was not Greek, to the Romans whoever was neither.

phrases.latin: quō neque noster adit quisquam, nec barbarus audet
phrases.english: where none of our people goes and no barbarian dares to
